verdict.rationale: incident.io documents more than 40 alert sources from observability tools, including Honeycomb and New Relic, plus a custom HTTP source. It also routes alerts to escalation paths by team, service, or other attributes, and supports priority and working-hours rules and team assignment of alert sources. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on configuring condition-based alert routes (expression/filter syntax), independent or hands-on corroboration of routing behavior.

support.subject: As an SRE, alerts from my monitoring tools are ingested through documented sources and routed to the right team by conditions I define

citations.quote: We have over 40 alert sources ready to go, plus the ability to roll your own via HTTP.
Escalations: Route alerts to the appropriate escalation paths, schedules, and team members.
On-call routes alerts by team, service, or anything else that makes sense.
Teams can now assign an alert source to a team, regardless to what is in the payload.
You can now set up rules around priority and/or working hours to ensure you page the right people at the right time without causing additional noise.
Receive alerts from New Relic to create escalations and incidents.
